```{r}
rna_raw  <- read_csv(rna_path,  show_col_types = FALSE)
```

ID checks + keep overlapping samples
```{r}
# Rename ID columns to avoid confusion
pred <- pred_raw %>% rename(sample_id = `...1`)
rna  <- rna_raw  %>% rename(gene_id   = `...1`)

# Extract IDs
pred_ids <- pred$sample_id
rna_ids  <- colnames(rna)[-1]   # all columns except gene_id

# Duplicate checks
dup_pred <- pred_ids[duplicated(pred_ids)]
dup_rna  <- rna_ids[duplicated(rna_ids)]

cat("Duplicate sample IDs in prediction table:", length(unique(dup_pred)), "\n")
cat("Duplicate sample IDs in RNA matrix     :", length(unique(dup_rna)), "\n")

# Overlap
overlap_ids <- intersect(pred_ids, rna_ids)

cat("Unique prediction IDs:", length(unique(pred_ids)), "\n")
cat("Unique RNA IDs       :", length(unique(rna_ids)), "\n")
cat("Overlapping IDs      :", length(overlap_ids), "\n")

# Keep only overlapping samples
pred_ov <- pred %>% filter(sample_id %in% overlap_ids)

# Subset RNA to overlapping sample columns (keep gene_id + overlap columns)
rna_ov <- rna %>% select(gene_id, all_of(overlap_ids))

pred_ov <- pred_ov %>% slice(match(overlap_ids, sample_id))
stopifnot(identical(pred_ov$sample_id, colnames(rna_ov)[-1]))

#MSI indeterminate
pred_ov <- pred_ov %>%
  mutate(
    msi_status = trimws(as.character(msi_status)),
    msi_status = ifelse(tolower(msi_status) %in% c("indeterminate", "indetermined"), NA, msi_status)
  )

cat("\nAfter filtering:\n")
cat("Prediction rows:", nrow(pred_ov), "\n")
cat("RNA columns    :", ncol(rna_ov), "(includes gene_id)\n")

cat("\nAlignment check (first 10 IDs):\n")
print(head(pred_ov$sample_id, 10))
print(head(colnames(rna_ov)[-1], 10))

cat("\nAligned? ", identical(pred_ov$sample_id, colnames(rna_ov)[-1]), "\n")

```

Missingness checks
```{r}
# Columns we must check (exactly as in your checklist)
cols_check <- c(
  "msi_status",
  "TMB", "TBL", "fraction_genome_altered", "aneuploidy_score",
  "TP53", "KRAS", "BRAF", "APC", "TTN"
)

# Sanity: are all columns present?

  stop(paste("These columns are missing in pred_ov:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

# % missing per column

  summarise(across(all_of(cols_check), ~ mean(is.na(.) | . == "") * 100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "pct_missing") %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))
```

Distribution checks
```{r}
num_targets <- c("TMB", "TBL", "fraction_genome_altered", "aneuploidy_score")

dist_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(num_targets, function(v) {

  x_all <- pred_ov[[v]]
  n_total <- length(x_all)
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(x_all) | x_all == "")
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_all))
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      variable = v,
      n_total = n_total,
      n_missing = n_missing,
      n_used = 0,
      min = NA_real_, q1 = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, q3 = NA_real_, max = NA_real_,
      range = NA_real_,
      skewness = NA_real_,
      outliers_iqr = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  q1 <- as.numeric(quantile(x, 0.25, names = FALSE))
  q3 <- as.numeric(quantile(x, 0.75, names = FALSE))
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  low <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  high <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  out_n <- sum(x < low | x > high)

  tibble(
    variable = v,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_missing = n_missing,
    n_used = length(x),
    min = min(x),
    q1 = q1,
    median = median(x),
    q3 = q3,
    max = max(x),
    range = max(x) - min(x),
    skewness = e1071::skewness(x, type = 2),
    outliers_iqr = out_n
  )
})

dist_tbl
```

Dataset for MSI-based tests
```{r}
msi_df <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(!is.na(msi_status), msi_status != "") %>%
  mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L", "MSI-H")))

cat("Rows in msi_df:", nrow(msi_df), "\n")
msi_df %>% count(msi_status)
```

MSI vs TMB
```{r}
# 1) Create transformed variable (handles skew; safe if TMB can be 0)
msi_df <- msi_df %>%
  mutate(logTMB = log1p(TMB))

# 2) Quick visual check
ggplot(msi_df, aes(x = msi_status, y = logTMB)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "log1p(TMB) by MSI class", x = "MSI class", y = "log1p(TMB)")

# 3) Fit one-way ANOVA
fit_tmb <- aov(logTMB ~ msi_status, data = msi_df)
summary(fit_tmb)

# 4) Post-hoc pairwise comparisons (Tukey)
TukeyHSD(fit_tmb)

# 5) Diagnostic plots (assumption checks)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(fit_tmb, which = 1)  # residuals vs fitted (variance / patterns)
plot(fit_tmb, which = 2)  # Q-Q plot (normality of residuals)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# --- PCA of RNA expression, colored by MSI (MSS / MSI-L / MSI-H) ---

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1) Keep only samples that have an MSI label
msi_pca_meta <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(!is.na(msi_status), msi_status != "") %>%
  mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L", "MSI-H"))) %>%
  select(sample_id, msi_status)

cat("Samples with MSI label:", nrow(msi_pca_meta), "\n")

# 2) Build count matrix with gene IDs as rownames (genes x samples)
rna_msi <- rna_ov %>%
  select(gene_id, all_of(msi_pca_meta$sample_id))

X_counts <- as.matrix(rna_msi[, -1])
rownames(X_counts) <- rna_msi$gene_id
storage.mode(X_counts) <- "numeric"

cat("Counts matrix dims (genes x samples):", nrow(X_counts), "x", ncol(X_counts), "\n")

# 3) Filter low-expression genes (adjust if it filters too aggressively)
# Keep genes with >=10 counts in at least 10 samples
keep_genes <- rowSums(X_counts >= 10) >= 10
X_counts_f <- X_counts[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Genes before filter:", nrow(X_counts), "\n")
cat("Genes after filter :", nrow(X_counts_f), "\n")

# If you get 0 genes after filtering, relax the rule:
if (nrow(X_counts_f) == 0) {
  cat("Filter too strict -> relaxing filter (>=1 count in >=5 samples)\n")
  keep_genes <- rowSums(X_counts >= 1) >= 5
  X_counts_f <- X_counts[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("Genes after relaxed filter:", nrow(X_counts_f), "\n")
}

stopifnot(nrow(X_counts_f) > 2)
stopifnot(ncol(X_counts_f) > 2)

# 4) Library-size normalization to CPM + log transform (base R)
lib_sizes <- colSums(X_counts_f)
cpm_mat <- sweep(X_counts_f, 2, lib_sizes, FUN = "/") * 1e6
logCPM <- log1p(cpm_mat)  # genes x samples

cat("logCPM dims:", nrow(logCPM), "x", ncol(logCPM), "\n")

# 5) Keep top variable genes (e.g. 2000)
gene_var <- apply(logCPM, 1, var)
gene_var <- gene_var[!is.na(gene_var)]

topN <- min(2000, length(gene_var))
cat("Genes available for ranking:", length(gene_var), " | Using topN:", topN, "\n")
stopifnot(topN > 2)

top_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:topN]
logCPM_top <- logCPM[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

cat("logCPM_top dims:", nrow(logCPM_top), "x", ncol(logCPM_top), "\n")

# 6) PCA (samples as rows, genes as columns)
pca <- prcomp(t(logCPM_top), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# 7) Prepare plot df
pca_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id = rownames(pca$x),
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2]
) %>%
  left_join(msi_pca_meta, by = "sample_id")

# % variance explained for axis labels
var_exp <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = msi_status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("PCA of RNA expression (top ", topN, " variable genes, logCPM)"),
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * var_exp[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "MSI"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)

# --- 1) metadata: keep MSS + MSI-L only ---
meta_2 <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(!is.na(msi_status), msi_status != "") %>%
  mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L", "MSI-H"))) %>%
  filter(msi_status %in% c("MSS", "MSI-L")) %>%
  select(sample_id, msi_status)

table(meta_2$msi_status)

# --- 2) counts matrix (genes x samples) aligned with meta_2 ---
rna_2 <- rna_ov %>% select(gene_id, all_of(meta_2$sample_id))
Y <- as.matrix(rna_2[, -1])
rownames(Y) <- rna_2$gene_id
storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"

stopifnot(identical(colnames(Y), meta_2$sample_id))

# --- 3) edgeR pipeline ---
dge <- DGEList(counts = Y, group = meta_2$msi_status)

# Filter low expression (reasonable default)
keep <- filterByExpr(dge)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = dge$samples)  # MSS baseline, MSI-L effect
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design)

# MSI-L vs MSS
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)

de <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table
de$gene_id <- rownames(de)

# --- 4) Add a simple "separation score": AUC (MSS vs MSI-L) using logCPM ---
logCPM <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

# rank-based AUC from Mann–Whitney U (no extra packages)
auc_from_scores <- function(scores, labels, positive = "MSI-L") {
  # scores: numeric vector
  # labels: factor/char with two classes
  labs <- as.character(labels)
  pos <- labs == positive
  n1 <- sum(pos)
  n0 <- sum(!pos)
  r <- rank(scores, ties.method = "average")
  U <- sum(r[pos]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2
  U / (n1 * n0)
}

labels <- meta_2$msi_status
auc_vec <- apply(logCPM, 1, auc_from_scores, labels = labels, positive = "MSI-L")

de$AUC <- auc_vec[de$gene_id]
de$abs_logFC <- abs(de$logFC)
de$sep_AUC <- pmax(de$AUC, 1 - de$AUC)  # 0.5 no separation; closer to 1 = better

# --- 5) A ranked table for "nice separation" ---
# You can tune these thresholds depending on what you get
best_sep <- de %>%
  mutate(FDR = as.numeric(FDR)) %>%
  arrange(desc(sep_AUC), FDR) %>%
  select(gene_id, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR, AUC, sep_AUC) %>%
  head(50)

best_sep
```

```{r}
# build long table: samples x genes
plot_df <- data.frame(

  arrange(desc(sep_AUC), FDR)

strong_candidates %>% head(30)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# --- Install/load packages (only if missing) ---
if (!"BiocManager" %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]) install.packages("BiocManager")

bioc_req <- c("fgsea")
cran_req <- c("dplyr", "msigdbr", "ggplot2", "tibble")

for (p in cran_req) {
  if (!p %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]) install.packages(p)
}
for (p in bioc_req) {
  if (!p %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]) BiocManager::install(p, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(ggplot2)

# --- 1) Build a ranked gene list for GSEA ---
# Use a ranking that combines direction + strength of evidence.
# Larger = more up in MSI-L; smaller = more up in MSS.
# (This is common for GSEA when you have p-values + logFC)
rank_tbl <- de %>%
  mutate(
    gene = gene_id,
    score = sign(logFC) * (-log10(PValue))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", is.finite(score)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(score = max(score), .groups = "drop") %>%   # handle duplicates by keeping strongest
  arrange(desc(score))

ranks <- rank_tbl$score
names(ranks) <- rank_tbl$gene
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

cat("Genes in ranked list:", length(ranks), "\n")

# --- 2) Get MSigDB Hallmark pathways (Human) ---
msig_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

pathways <- split(msig_h$gene_symbol, msig_h$gs_name)
cat("Hallmark pathways:", length(pathways), "\n")

# --- 3) Run fgsea (multilevel is robust) ---
set.seed(1)
fg <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = pathways, stats = ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)

fg_res <- fg %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj)

fg_res %>% select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>% head(15)
```

```{r}
ggplot(fg_plot, aes(x = reorder(pathway, NES), y = NES)) +
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# --- Install/load edgeR if needed ---
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("edgeR", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("edgeR", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)

# --- 1) Keep only MSI-H and MSS samples ---
mh_meta <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(!is.na(msi_status), msi_status %in% c("MSI-H", "MSS")) %>%
  mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-H"))) %>%
  select(sample_id, msi_status)

cat("Samples kept:\n")
print(table(mh_meta$msi_status))

# --- 2) Build count matrix: genes x samples (edgeR expects this) ---
rna_mh <- rna_ov %>% select(gene_id, all_of(mh_meta$sample_id))

Y <- as.matrix(rna_mh[, -1])
rownames(Y) <- rna_mh$gene_id
storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"

stopifnot(identical(colnames(Y), mh_meta$sample_id))

cat("Count matrix dims (genes x samples):", nrow(Y), "x", ncol(Y), "\n")

# --- 3) edgeR pipeline: filter, normalize, fit model, test ---
dge <- DGEList(counts = Y, group = mh_meta$msi_status)

# Filter low-expression genes (recommended edgeR method)
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = mh_meta$msi_status)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Genes kept after filterByExpr:", nrow(dge), "\n")

# TMM normalization
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

# Design matrix for MSI-H vs MSS
design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = dge$samples)  # groupMSI-H coefficient tests MSI-H vs MSS

# Dispersion + fit
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design)

# Test: MSI-H vs MSS (the groupMSI-H coefficient)
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "groupMSI-H")

# --- 4) Results table ---
res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    logFC = logFC,
    logCPM = logCPM,
    PValue = PValue,
    FDR = FDR
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

# Preview top hits
res %>% select(gene_id, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR) %>% head(20)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(tibble)

# Hallmark pathways once
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
pathways <- split(hallmark$gene_symbol, hallmark$gs_name)

run_gsea_half <- function(sample_ids, label_df, rna_ov, pathways) {

  meta <- label_df %>%
    filter(sample_id %in% sample_ids) %>%
    mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L"))) %>%
    select(sample_id, msi_status)

  rna_sub <- rna_ov %>% select(gene_id, all_of(meta$sample_id))
  Y <- as.matrix(rna_sub[, -1])
  rownames(Y) <- rna_sub$gene_id
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(Y), meta$sample_id))

  dge <- DGEList(counts = Y, group = meta$msi_status)
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = meta$msi_status)
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = dge$samples)
  dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
  fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design)

  # identify correct coef name robustly (second column)
  coef_name <- colnames(design)[2]
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = coef_name)

  res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table %>% rownames_to_column("gene_id")
  rank_stat <- sign(res$logFC) * (-log10(res$PValue))
  names(rank_stat) <- res$gene_id
  rank_stat <- sort(rank_stat, decreasing = TRUE)

  fg <- fgsea(pathways = pathways, stats = rank_stat, nperm = 5000) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    arrange(padj)

  fg
}

# Build label df for MSI-L vs MSS only
label_df <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(!is.na(msi_status), msi_status %in% c("MSS", "MSI-L")) %>%
  mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L"))) %>%
  select(sample_id, msi_status)

set.seed(42)

# Stratified split
mss_ids  <- label_df %>% filter(msi_status == "MSS") %>% pull(sample_id)
msil_ids <- label_df %>% filter(msi_status == "MSI-L") %>% pull(sample_id)

mss_A  <- sample(mss_ids,  length(mss_ids)  %/% 2)
msil_A <- sample(msil_ids, length(msil_ids) %/% 2)

halfA <- c(mss_A, msil_A)
halfB <- setdiff(label_df$sample_id, halfA)

cat("Half A counts:\n"); print(table(label_df$msi_status[label_df$sample_id %in% halfA]))
cat("Half B counts:\n"); print(table(label_df$msi_status[label_df$sample_id %in% halfB]))

# Run GSEA on each half
fg_A <- run_gsea_half(halfA, label_df, rna_ov, pathways)
fg_B <- run_gsea_half(halfB, label_df, rna_ov, pathways)

# Compare: which pathways are significant in both halves?
sigA <- fg_A %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% select(pathway, NES, padj) %>% rename(NES_A = NES, padj_A = padj)
sigB <- fg_B %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% select(pathway, NES, padj) %>% rename(NES_B = NES, padj_B = padj)

both <- inner_join(sigA, sigB, by = "pathway") %>%
  mutate(same_direction = sign(NES_A) == sign(NES_B)) %>%
  arrange(padj_A, padj_B)

cat("Pathways significant in BOTH halves:\n")
both

# Specifically check your two pathways in both halves (even if not significant)
check_paths <- c("HALLMARK_PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS", "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_DN")

fg_A %>% filter(pathway %in% check_paths) %>% select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size)
fg_B %>% filter(pathway %in% check_paths) %>% select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size)
```

```{r}
# --- MSI-L vs MSS mutation differences (WT vs SNV/INDEL/etc.) ---

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

mut_genes <- c("TP53", "KRAS", "BRAF", "APC", "TTN")

ml_df <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(!is.na(msi_status), msi_status %in% c("MSS", "MSI-L")) %>%
  mutate(msi_status = factor(msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L"))) %>%
  select(sample_id, msi_status, all_of(mut_genes))

# 0) sanity check: see the raw encodings
purrr::map(mut_genes, ~ sort(unique(ml_df[[.x]]))) |> setNames(mut_genes)

# Helper: convert WT/SNV/etc -> WT vs Mut
to_mut_status <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  x[x == ""] <- NA

  # mutated encodings (include SNV!)
  is_mut <- x %in% c("snv", "indel", "cnv", "sv", "mut", "mutated", "1", "true", "yes") |
    str_detect(x, "snv") |
    str_detect(x, "indel") |
    str_detect(x, "frameshift") |
    str_detect(x, "missense") |
    str_detect(x, "nonsense") |
    str_detect(x, "splice") |
    str_detect(x, "del") |
    str_detect(x, "ins") |
    str_detect(x, "trunc")

  # WT encodings
  is_wt <- x %in% c("wt", "wildtype", "wild-type", "0", "false", "no") |
    str_detect(x, "^wt$") |
    str_detect(x, "wild")

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[is_mut] <- "Mut"
  out[is_wt]  <- "WT"
  out
}

ml_long <- ml_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(mut_genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "raw") %>%
  mutate(status = to_mut_status(raw)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(status)) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("WT", "Mut")))

# 1) Mutation % table
prop_tbl <- ml_long %>%
  count(gene, msi_status, status, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(gene, msi_status) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

prop_tbl

# 2) Fisher/Chi-square per gene
run_test_one_gene <- function(g) {
  tmp <- ml_long %>% filter(gene == g)
  tab <- table(tmp$msi_status, tmp$status)  # MSS/MSI-L x WT/Mut

  # force 2x2 shape
  if (!all(c("WT","Mut") %in% colnames(tab))) {
    for (cname in setdiff(c("WT","Mut"), colnames(tab))) tab <- cbind(tab, setNames(rep(0, nrow(tab)), cname))
    tab <- tab[, c("WT","Mut"), drop = FALSE]
  }

  # choose test
  chisq_ok <- TRUE
  suppressWarnings({
    exp_counts <- chisq.test(tab)$expected
    chisq_ok <- all(exp_counts >= 5)
  })

  if (chisq_ok) {
    test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE))
    test_name <- "Chi-square"
    pval <- test$p.value
    or <- (tab["MSI-L","Mut"] / tab["MSI-L","WT"]) / (tab["MSS","Mut"] / tab["MSS","WT"])
  } else {
    test <- fisher.test(tab)
    test_name <- "Fisher"
    pval <- test$p.value
    or <- as.numeric(test$estimate)
  }

  tibble(
    gene = g,
    test = test_name,
    p_value = pval,
    odds_ratio_MSI_L_vs_MSS = or,
    mut_pct_MSS  = 100 * tab["MSS","Mut"]   / sum(tab["MSS", ]),
    mut_pct_MSI_L= 100 * tab["MSI-L","Mut"] / sum(tab["MSI-L", ]),
    MSS_WT = tab["MSS","WT"], MSS_Mut = tab["MSS","Mut"],
    MSIL_WT = tab["MSI-L","WT"], MSIL_Mut = tab["MSI-L","Mut"]
  )
}

gene_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(mut_genes, run_test_one_gene) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

gene_tests

# 3) Plot: % mutated
plot_df <- prop_tbl %>%
  filter(status == "Mut") %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * prop)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = gene, y = pct, fill = msi_status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Mutation frequency by MSI class (MSS vs MSI-L)",
    x = "Gene",
    y = "% Mutated",
    fill = "MSI"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

genes <- c("KRAS", "BRAF", "APC", "TP53")

df <- pred_ov %>%
  filter(msi_status %in% c("MSS", "MSI-L")) %>%
  select(sample_id, msi_status, all_of(genes)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(genes), ~ as.integer(. != 0)))  # 0/1

res <- map_dfr(genes, function(g) {

  tmp <- df %>%
    select(msi_status, mut = all_of(g)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(msi_status), !is.na(mut))

  # Force factors so table is ALWAYS 2x2
  tab <- table(
    factor(tmp$msi_status, levels = c("MSS", "MSI-L")),
    factor(tmp$mut, levels = c(0, 1))
  )

  ft <- fisher.test(tab)

  rate_mss  <- mean(tmp$mut[tmp$msi_status == "MSS"] == 1)
  rate_msil <- mean(tmp$mut[tmp$msi_status == "MSI-L"] == 1)

  tibble(
    gene = g,
    MSS_mut_rate = rate_mss,
    MSIL_mut_rate = rate_msil,
    odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
    p_value = ft$p.value,
    MSS_mut_n = tab["MSS", "1"],
    MSS_total = sum(tab["MSS", ]),
    MSIL_mut_n = tab["MSI-L", "1"],
    MSIL_total = sum(tab["MSI-L", ])
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

res

for (g in genes) {
  tmp <- df %>% select(msi_status, mut = all_of(g)) %>% filter(!is.na(msi_status), !is.na(mut))
  tab_raw <- table(tmp$msi_status, tmp$mut)
  cat("\n", g, "\n")
  print(tab_raw)
}
```
